body:
Samir: FYI we have a sev2 from Acme — p95 for /v1/generate jumped from ~120ms to ~420ms starting ~11:02 UTC. P99s also up. Customer is seeing timeouts. Dashboard A and the SLO panel disagree on magnitude. Can someone triage? :eyes:
Lena: on it. any trace ids or examples from the customer?
support-bot: Customer attached traces: trace-abc123, trace-def456. Reported window 11:01–11:15 UTC.
metrics-bot: Alert: p95-api-generate > 300ms triggered at 11:08 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: service/generator v2.0 -> at 10:58 UTC canary 10% -> promoted 11:00 -> 100% at 11:05 (job #8241).
Diego: pulling traces now. Quick glance: a lot of requests show a long first-token delay, subsequent tokens fine.
Lena: important note: our histogram panel is using raw bucket counts from ingest; the SLO panel uses 1m rollups with sample_weight. If sampling changed (or weighting is wrong) quantiles can diverge.
Samir: links: <https://grafana.redwood/s/generate-histogram|histogram> and <https://grafana.redwood/s/slo-p95|slo-p95>. See the flat step at 11:02 on the SLO panel.
Priya: infra note: eu-west-1 node pool had a transient CPU steal at 11:03 on a subset of pods — kernel reports spikes during model init. Could correlate with v2.0 loading behavior.
Diego: I can repro locally by hitting staging with headers that route to the new model. Repro command: ```hey -n 200 -c 20 https://staging/api/v1/generate -H 'X-Customer: acme' -H 'X-Seq-Len: 1024'``` results in p95 ~380ms when model loads cold. Without cold starts p95 ~110ms.
Lena: mitigation options: 1) rollback v2.0 rollout, 2) enable prefix/KV cache warming for Acme route, 3) bump dedicated pool size temporarily, 4) adjust metric rollup weighting while we investigate.
Samir: priority: minimize customer impact. If rollback is low-friction we should do it until we patch v2.0. Thoughts?
Diego: v2.0 change added an extra tokenizer init on first request which explains first-token tail. I can prepare a patch to lazy-init. Rolling back is low-risk.
metrics-bot: FYI I ran a re-aggregation with corrected sample_weight mapping at 11:32 UTC; new rollups are available now. After re-agg, SLO panel p95 aligns with histogram for the same time window.
Lena: can confirm — mismatch was largely sample_weight + rollout timing. When sample rates changed during canary promotion, rollup quantile math was skewed. I'll add a note to the dashboard describing the difference and link to runbook.
support-bot: Customer updated: 'we see latency improving after ~11:40, thanks' :thumbsup:
Samir: Actions: 1) Diego to revert v2.0 canary (or apply lazy-init patch) — Diego, 2) Diego to PR metrics fix (already ran re-agg) — Diego, 3) Lena to update dashboards + runbook note — Lena. I'll follow up with Acme SRE. Closing when customer confirms stable for 30m.
Diego: rolled back v2.0 at 11:20 UTC (rollback job #8248). Patch PR: https://git.redwood/infra/generator/pull/912 (lazy-init).
Lena: added dashboard annotation at 11:34 and a short explainer in the panel: 'rollup vs histogram divergence can occur when sample rates change during rollups; prefer raw histogram for incident triage.'
Samir: customer reports p95 back to baseline after 11:40. I'll close the escalation after 30m stable. Thanks all! :tada:
